completeness.why: getDateWithSkippedWeekend now takes the enable flag and decides whether and how to move the date; every site passes its own flag and mode under its own field names. getNextDate keeps only its site-specific noSkipWeekend option (a variation no other site has), and the template sites' new null guard is day-string/date conversion, not part of the decision.

interface.why: A single boolean enable parameter captures the real variation and each caller maps its own field names, but it defaults to true even though every caller now passes it explicitly, a leftover that lets a future caller silently skip the flag.

disguised_duplication.where: The enable ternaries were removed into the shared function; the two createScheduleList blocks remain parallel copies of the day/date conversion as before, not disguised.
